title: מרימר ומר זוטרא תלמידי רב הונא

paragraphs: Meremar and Mar Zutra, Rav Huna's students. I did not find that Meremar was Rav Huna's student. Mar Zutra did expound in Rav Huna's name at the end of BaKol Me'arvin. We find Meremar many times with Ravina, who lived in Rav Ashi's time, as I shall write shortly below; what connection has Meremar to Mar Zutra? There does appear to have been an early Meremar: Rav Ḥisda said—שס״ח [provisionally the new Shas] reads R. Yirmeyah said—Meremar expounded, Gittin 88a. But we have not found Meremar together with Mar Zutra as Rav Huna's student.
